description: This file contains the class `Zone` which is part of the Opencart Admin Model for Localisation. It manages CRUD operations and retrieval of geographical zone data such as adding, editing, deleting, and fetching zones and zones by country ID in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Zone
classes.description: Model class for managing geographical zones within the localisation namespace in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addZone
methods.description: Inserts a new zone record into the database and clears related cache.

methods.name: editZone
methods.description: Updates an existing zone record identified by zone_id and clears related cache.

methods.name: deleteZone
methods.description: Deletes a zone record by zone_id and clears related cache.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific zone by zone_id.

methods.name: getZones
methods.description: Fetches a list of zones with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalZones
methods.description: Counts total zones with optional filtering, for pagination or reporting.

methods.name: getZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Retrieves all zones associated with a specific country ID, using caching.

methods.name: getTotalZonesByCountryId
methods.description: Calculates the total number of zones for a particular country ID.
